title: Verify: playSceneTransition unit tests with a mocked context
summary: Test the helper with a fake EffectRenderContext
description: Add game/tests/playSceneTransition.test.ts reusing the fake-context pattern and validScene fixture from tests/buildEffects.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: playTransition called once with 400 for a fade scene
playTransition not called without a transition entry or effects

steps.action: Create the test file with a fake context ({createEffect: vi.fn(), playTransition: vi.fn()}) and validScene from ./fixtures/valid-world. Test 1 'plays the fade with the content duration': scene effects [{type:'transition',kind:'fade',durationMs:400}, dust spec]; call playSceneTransition; expect playTransition toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1) and toHaveBeenCalledWith(400). Test 2 'plays a different authored duration': durationMs 750 expects 750. Test 3 'does nothing without a transition entry': effects [dust spec] and a scene with no effects key; expect playTransition not called.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/playSceneTransition.test.ts
